verdict.rationale: Financial Connections is a bank-data API, so user-configured background automations are a fair axis to ask about. The evidence does not show the product offering one. Refresh-complete webhooks and the 'balance and transaction monitoring' agent use case via Link CLI are developer building blocks or listed use cases, not a documented, user-configurable autonomous automation or schedule feature. The community mention of 'daily pulls' describes a data-refresh limit, not automations a user sets up.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
